name: Minnesota 4-H
org: University of Minnesota Extension, Minnesota 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club or county program. You learn by doing and grow as a young person outside of school.
grades: Kindergarten through one year past high school (grade 13)
who_can_apply: Anyone from kindergarten through one year past high school. Independent membership means you are not in a club. It needs 6th grade or older and at least two years of 4-H club experience. It also needs an adult 4-H volunteer as your mentor.
pay_detail: Minnesota 4-H does not charge a state membership fee. Some local clubs or programs charge dues, and help may be available.
duration: One 4-H year runs Oct. 1 through Sept. 30. You re-enroll each year.
deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the Join page. Membership lasts Oct. 1 to Sept. 30 and you re-enroll each year.
how_to_apply: Get in touch with local 4-H staff near you, or fill out the interest form. Then complete your enrollment online or with a paper form.
notes: Clubs and costs can differ by county, so contact your county 4-H staff first. This is a youth club and learning program, not a paid job.
